content:
alex: Free pickup  CalDigit TS3 Plus dock (USB-C) + IKEA Markus office chair (black) - decluttering before move. I'll drop both in the SF office mailroom (Floor 3). DM to claim, i'll label. Pics on request.

sam: quick Q - dock compatible with M1 MacBook Air?

alex: yes, USB-C host mode. no TB tunneling but display + charging works for most M1 setups.

maria: claiming the chair if still available. any stains?

alex: minor scuff on arm, otherwise good. seat foam still firm.
jordan: im interested in the dock. @sam if you want it more, go ahead, otherwise i'll swing by after standup. can you hold until 3pm?
sam: if jordan wants it take it, otherwise i'll try to pick up at 4:30.

ops-bot: Please include a "claim by" time for item giveaways and mark items with your name to avoid LOST property reports 🚀

alex: noted - leaving a Post-it on both: 

Pickup: alex
Items: CalDigit TS3 Plus dock / IKEA Markus chair
Claim by: 15:30
Location: Floor 3 mailroom (next to kitchen)

maria: awesome, i'll grab the chair around 2pm and shoot you a DM. thanks alex! :heart:
jordan: grabbing the dock after standup.
sam: backup in case something falls through. thanks :)
alex: thanks all, leaving both items now. :thumbsup:
